verdict.rationale: Factory supports scaling via API-driven session creation (create/manage many Droid sessions independently), droid exec for CI/CD and batch processing, and Missions for orchestrating large multi-feature work, all of which enable running multiple agent tasks in parallel. However, no explicit documentation quantifies concurrency limits, dashboards for monitoring many simultaneous sessions, or engineering-lead-specific throughput metrics. missing for 10: explicit concurrency/parallelism limits or guarantees, a UI/dashboard for managing many simultaneous sessions, and independent evidence of real-world parallel scaling.
